summary: Schedule - 500 Error on July 23rd and Table Loading Issues After Location Change
reported_issue: Opening the Scheduler and navigating (Prev/Next/calendar) to July 23rd triggered a 500 error, specific to July 23rd only. Also: changing location did not auto-load the schedule (required manual refresh), and errors occurred when a location had no departments/staff.
expected_after_fix: Schedule loads for any date including July 23rd without a 500; switching location auto-loads the schedule; no error when a location has no departments/staff.
steps_i_followed: Identified the schedule data endpoint via network capture: GET /api/calendar?date=...&end_date=...
Loaded /schedule in the SPA (admin) and navigated forward several days via the next-day chevron while capturing every /api/calendar response status
Checked the rendered page for any error/500/'something went wrong' banner after navigation
actual_now: The /api/calendar endpoint returned HTTP 200 for every date tested, including July 23rd of both 2025 and 2026 (no 500). In the SPA, navigating day-by-day (July 3 -> 6) produced /api/calendar calls that all returned 200, and no error banner appeared. The specific July-23rd 500 no longer occurs.
notes: Primary reported defect (500 on July 23rd) is resolved; verified both via direct API and UI navigation. The secondary sub-issues (location-switch auto-load, empty-location handling) were not independently reproduced in this session as only one location was exercised, but no errors were observed during navigation.
